### pk-residual-one
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE $key = 'u' AND price > 10
---
ns=1
project=documents
access=pk-get key="u"
residual:

### pk-residual-two
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE $key = 'u' AND price > 10 AND name = 'x'
---
ns=1
project=documents
access=pk-get key="u"
residual:
  and n=2
    cmp op=gt path=$.price const=i64:10
    cmp op=eq path=$.name const=utf8:"x"
